cat >> test_etl_pipeline.py <<'EOF'


class TraceFlag(unittest.TestCase):
    STEPS = [
        {"op": "filter", "where": "x > 0"},
        {"op": "branch", "branches": [
            {"when": "x > 5", "steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "big", "expr": "true"}]},
            {"when": "x > 100", "steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 1}]},
            {"when": "otherwise", "steps": []},
        ]},
        {"op": "LIMIT", "n": 2},
    ]
    DATASET = [{"x": 1}, {"x": 7}, {"x": -1}, {"x": 3}]

    def test_spec_example(self):
        code, out = run_cli(request(self.STEPS, self.DATASET), args=("--execute", "--trace"))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(out, {
            "status": "ok",
            "data": [{"x": 7, "big": True}, {"x": 1}],
            "metrics": {"rows_in": 4, "rows_out": 2},
            "trace": [
                {"path": "pipeline.steps[0]", "op": "filter", "rows_in": 4, "rows_out": 3},
                {"path": "pipeline.steps[1]", "op": "branch", "rows_in": 3, "rows_out": 3},
                {"path": "pipeline.steps[1].branches[0].steps[0]", "op": "map", "rows_in": 1, "rows_out": 1},
                {"path": "pipeline.steps[1].branches[1].steps[0]", "op": "limit", "rows_in": 0, "rows_out": 0},
                {"path": "pipeline.steps[2]", "op": "limit", "rows_in": 3, "rows_out": 2},
            ],
        })

    def test_nested_branch_order(self):
        steps = [{"op": "branch", "branches": [
            {"when": "otherwise", "steps": [
                {"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "otherwise", "steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 5}]}]},
                {"op": "limit", "n": 1},
            ]},
        ]}]
        _, out = run_cli(request(steps, [{"a": 1}, {"a": 2}]), args=("--execute", "--trace"))
        self.assertEqual([(e["path"], e["rows_in"], e["rows_out"]) for e in out["trace"]], [
            ("pipeline.steps[0]", 2, 1),
            ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[0]", 2, 2),
            ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[0].branches[0].steps[0]", 2, 2),
            ("pipeline.steps[0].branches[0].steps[1]", 2, 1),
        ])

    def test_empty_pipeline_has_empty_trace(self):
        _, out = run_cli(request([], [{"a": 1}]), args=("--execute", "--trace"))
        self.assertEqual(out["trace"], [])

    def test_ignored_without_execute(self):
        payload = request(self.STEPS, self.DATASET)
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(payload, args=("--trace",)), run_cli(payload))
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(payload, args=("--execute=false", "--trace")), run_cli(payload))

    def test_absent_without_flag(self):
        _, out = run_cli(request(self.STEPS, self.DATASET), args=("--execute", "--trace=false"))
        self.assertNotIn("trace", out)

    def test_error_response_unchanged(self):
        payload = request([{"op": "select", "columns": ["q"]}], [{"x": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(payload, args=("--execute", "--trace")), run_cli(payload, args=("--execute",)))
        self.assertEqual(run_cli(payload, args=("--execute", "--trace"))[0], 1)
